title: A Koszul complex in quaternionic analysis and its applications
summary: Let $n\geqslant 1, Ω\subset\mathbb{H}^n $ be a domain. We construct a Koszul-type complex for the ideal sheaf $\mathcal{I}_X^{(k)}$ of $k$-regular functions vanishing on $X=\{(q_0, q_1, \cdots, q_{n-1})\in Ω: q_0=0\}$ in several quaternionic variables: $$0\to \mathcal{R}^{(k+2)}\xrightarrow{\widetilde{\mathscr{L}}^{(k)}} \mathcal{R}^{(k+1)}\oplus\mathcal{R}^{(k+1)}\xrightarrow{\mathscr{L}^{(k)}} \mathcal{I}_X^{(k)}\to 0,$$ where $k\geqslant 0$, $\mathcal{R}^{(k)}$ is the sheaf of $k$-regular functions on $Ω$, $\widetilde{\mathscr{L}}^{(k)}=(-L_1^{(k+2)},L_0^{(k+2)})^{T}$,…
